text: Maintaining good health involves more than just avoiding illness—it requires a daily commitment to several simple habits. A balanced diet, rich in fruits, vegetables, and whole grains, provides the energy your body needs to function well. Regular exercise, even a brisk 30-minute walk, strengthens your heart and improves your mood. Equally important is sleep; getting seven to eight hours of quality rest helps your brain recover and keeps your immune system strong. However, don’t forget your mental health. Taking time to relax, practicing mindfulness, or talking to a friend can reduce stress. Finally, strive for a healthy work-life balance by setting boundaries between professional tasks and personal time. When you combine these elements, you create a foundation for lasting wellness.
